Additionally, 'Karine' has connections to the Greek 'Mary', which is also a significant and beloved name in Christianity.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name 'Karine' rests in its association with purity, devotion, and the strength of salvation. The Hebrew root 'Keren' means horn, and in this context, it can symbolize the horn of salvation, reminding us of God's ultimate protection and care. The name 'Karine' is also linked to the saints named throughout history who carried this name, including St. Carinthia of Trier, a virgin and martyr who stood firm in her faith and suffered for her dedication to God. Therefore, the name 'Karine' serves as a reminder of the power of faith and devotion to overcome adversity, and a call to remember the safety and refuge found in God's loving embrace.
